artworks.title: Title Plate
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring stone architecture with arches, stairs, ropes, and chains. There is a column with Italian text, stone blocks, a rounded archway, a wooden door or window, ropes, chains, and a relief sculpture of a figure. Cross-hatching is used for shadows and texture.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Lustful: Paolo and Francesca
artworks.description: The drawing depicts swirling figures and a radiant light. The composition shows intertwined, ethereal figures floating and entwined within a spiral. On the right side, there is a robed figure standing next to another figure lying on the ground. The drawing suggests a sense of movement and transcendence. The intricate detailing of each figure, the celestial theme, and the use of swirling lines and radiant glow create a mystical ambiance.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Tormenting Ciampolo
artworks.description: The image shows figures in dynamic interaction surrounded by flames and an ocean backdrop. One figure extends an arm towards the other, who appears to recoil. Both characters have exaggerated faces. The background features turbulent, flame-like lines, enhancing the dramatic atmosphere. The illustration is detailed with defined musculature and a sense of narrative tension.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Corrupt Officials; the Devils Mauling Each Other
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two winged figures flying over swirling waters. The composition features two prominent figures in the foreground, each with elongated wings and muscular forms, depicted in mid-flight poses. Beneath them, the water is depicted with swirling patterns. In the background, on a slightly elevated plain, more figures can be seen along with a pair of figures. Part of the scene is a mountainous landscape with a few clouds in the sky. The line work is detailed, with cross-hatching used for shading and texture.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Agnolo Brunelleschi Attacked by a Six-Footed Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of serpents intertwining with figures. The central figure stands with a muscular form and a fierce expression. Its head is crowned with an ornate headdress. Surrounding this figure are two nude figures with expressions of distress or astonishment, recoiling slightly, with hands raised. On the left side, there are two robed figures observing the scene. The background features abstract and geometric shapes. Several serpentine creatures with scales and faces can be seen. The composition is detailed with intricate linework, demonstrating tension and movement within the scene.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Thieves; Buoso Donati Attacked by the Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures. Two figures on the left are dressed and observing, while the two central figures are nude. One central figure is contorting, possibly in response to a dragon-like creature below emitting smoke or flames. The background features jagged shapes and a dark sky with swirling clouds, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The style is reminiscent of classical European religious or mythological artwork.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Falsifiers: Dante and Virgil Covering their Noses because of the st
artworks.description: It is a drawing of a surreal landscape with figures and mountains depicted in an eerie and mystical style. The scene features dense, intricate line work creating a fantasy setting. In the left foreground, there is a configuration of reclining and seated figures intertwined with the landscape. On the right, two tall, cloaked figures with long beards and robes stand against the backdrop. The background shows mountainous terrain with clouds and swirling sky patterns. The line work creates a dynamic texture with rich detailing suggesting motion and intense mood.

artworks.title: The Circle of the Traitors; Dante's Foot Striking Bocca degli Abbate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two robed figures standing above a river filled with submerged, struggling, and deceased bodies. The central focus is on the figures in long, flowing robes. Submerged figures appear to float or struggle beneath the water's surface, with heads and outstretched hands visible. On the right side, there is a rocky terrain with faint outlines of faces. The sky above the figures is depicted with sketch-like lines. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Title-Page of the Engraved Illustrations to the Book of Job
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the frontispiece for "Illustrations of The Book of Job" by William Blake. The drawing features an intricate and decorative text design, primarily in English with Hebrew script at the top. The text in English reads "ILLUSTRATIONS of The BOOK of JOB Invented & Engraved by William Blake 1825." Surrounding the text are angelic figures with long flowing hair and wings, one of which is centrally positioned, reclining amidst the others. The entire piece is enclosed within a double-lined border. The detailed pen work and line intricacy are characteristic of William Blake's style.

artworks.title: Job and His Family
artworks.description: This drawing shows a gathering under a tree. The central panel features figures in robes around a central figure seated under a tree. Sheep are in the foreground with a large crescent moon in the sky. The background shows a landscape with hills and a city or village. Musical instruments are depicted intertwined with the tree branches. The border includes text with phrases like "Our Father, which art in Heaven" and details about a man named Job from the land of Uz. Below, there is an inscription emphasizing religious and moral undertones.

artworks.title: Satan Before the Throne of God
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures within a single frame. An aged man with long hair and a beard is seated at the top center, surrounded by other figures in various positions. The figures vary in appearance, attire, and poses, and are enclosed by ornate arches and borders with decorative elements. The backdrop features a sky with clouds, adding to the scene's celestial ambiance. Scroll-like banners with inscriptions are present in the composition.

artworks.title: The Destruction of Job's Sons
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central winged figure amidst swirling flames and human figures in motion. The scene is encased within a decorative border with accompanying text.

artworks.title: The Messengers Tell Job of His Misfortunes
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring human figures and a cross. The main figure gestures energetically, with clouds above and a cross behind. A woman sits to the right, holding a child, while another person leans on her. The setting appears outdoors, with a dramatic atmosphere. An inscription surrounding the image describes a narrative involving the destruction of livestock. The drawing includes swirling clouds and a bold horizon line, creating movement and tension. The style is reminiscent of William Blake.

artworks.title: Satan Going Forth from the Presence of the Lord
artworks.description: This is an intricate illustration featuring a central figure surrounded by angels in a divine setting. The scene includes earthly figures and animals below. The drawing has detailed border elements, including twisting snakes and vines, contributing to its symbolic theme.

artworks.title: Satan Smiting Job with Boils
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a mythological scene. Central to the image is a strong, nude figure with outstretched arms, surrounded by dark, swirling clouds against a glowing horizon. Two figures are in the foreground, one lying prostrate and another crouching with hands covering their face. Winged forms are present among the surrounding text, which quotes a biblical verse. The text above reads, "Naked came I out of my mother's womb & Naked shall I return thither The Lord gave & the Lord hath taken away, Blessed be the Name of the Lord," referencing a passage from the Book of Job. Below the illustration, the text states, "And smote Job with sore Boils from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head." The lower section displays small still-life elements, illustrating objects like a water jug and domestic items. The style resembles that of William Blake, known for his rich, symbolic imagery and integration of text and image.

artworks.title: Job's Comforters
artworks.description: This is a black and white print surrounded by text. In the print, several people are depicted on the left approaching a central man, who is seated and being supported by a woman behind him. The setting is a barren landscape with a city in the distance. The sky is stormy. Surrounding this print there are scripted words and motifs of people along the border.

artworks.title: Job's Despair
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The central figure is seated with legs bent and arms raised upward, with long hair, a beard, deeply etched facial features, and expressive body language. This person appears unclothed from the shoulders up, highlighting their muscles and form. On each side, there is another figure seated, one covering their face and the other resting their chin on their hand. The background features a mountainous landscape with swirling clouds and a stone structure on the right. The central image is surrounded by an ornate border with decorative foliage elements at the bottom and text excerpts at both the top and bottom of the page.

artworks.title: The Vision of Eliphaz
artworks.description: The image shows an ethereal figure surrounded by light appearing before several seated figures. The central figure is illuminated with an aura or halo, while the seated figures below look up in wonder. The border contains text, and the artwork features intricate line work and shading, creating an otherworldly atmosphere.

artworks.title: Job Rebuked by His Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting four figures in a dramatic moment. The central scene shows one seated figure and others gathered around, expressing emotions through gestures and facial expressions. The background features rolling hills against a dark sky. Above and below the central image are lines of text in an ornate script. The text reflects on themes of suffering, faith, and judgment. The border of the drawing includes artistic flourishes and two small illustrative creatures—a bird with a branch and an owl. The style is reminiscent of William Blake.

artworks.title: Job's Evil Dreams
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of intertwined creatures and forms with exaggerated features and serpentine elements in fine detail. Swirling lines and patterns interlace within the figures, creating a sense of movement. The border of the image features handwritten text with reflective sayings or quotations. The composition and line work suggest themes of transformation and struggle.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Elihu
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group gathered under a starry sky. The image depicts a standing figure, pointing upward toward an open sky dotted with stars, surrounded by seated figures in various poses. The central focus is on the interaction between the standing figure and the seated group. The figures are detailed and accompanied by text with poetic and biblical references. The painting is in the style of William Blake, featuring his fusion of visual art and poetic text as well as his themes of spiritual and existential reflection. The surrounding border includes artistically rendered text panels.

artworks.title: The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The central image depicts an encounter between a figure and two kneeling figures. The style is intricate with detailed line work capturing motion and emotion. Above and below the central illustration are texts revealing the narrative. The top reads, "Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge," while the bottom states, "Then the Lord answered Job out of the Whirlwind." The composition is framed in decorative borders, invoking a sense of divine interaction. The swirling lines convey a prophetic essence befitting the biblical story's drama.

artworks.title: The Creation
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a celestial scene with angels and symbolic imagery. In the central panel, a group of seven angels stand side by side with arms raised, surrounded by stars. Below them, an older figure appears commanding, while to his sides are figures kneeling. The surrounding border contains symbolic illustrations, including depictions of the sun and moon, and elements like waves and mountains. The illustration is accompanied by text that enhances the mystical and spiritual tone of the image.

artworks.title: Behemoth and Leviathan
artworks.description: This is a painting of fantastical creatures and celestial figures with scriptural text. The composition features a scene where mythical beings, including a majestic behemoth and a coiled serpent, are surrounded by angelic and human figures. The central image appears to be an illustration of biblical creatures with intricate detailing. Two ethereal angelic figures hover above, partially embracing or communicating with seated figures beneath them. The scene is rich in symbolism and detail, with ornamental borders embellished with flowing lines and accompanying scriptural text. This is in the style of William Blake, known for his illustrative style combining poetry, religious mythology, and fantastical elements.
